description:
I’m Marv Ostrander. I’ve spent a lifetime around the kind of household problems nobody thinks much about, until the lights go out and the refrigerator starts warming up.

This channel is about keeping the essentials running without buying more backup power than you need. We’ll look at power stations, batteries, generators, solar charging, extension-cord setups for individual appliances, and the real limits behind the numbers on the box.

If you want a calmer, more realistic plan for the next outage, you’re in the right place.
